note: Held-out suite (100 cases) generated independently of the rule patterns and NOT used to tune them. Labels follow dataset.json conventions: mustFlag = should be reported missing; mustNotFlag = stated/not applicable and must not be flagged. Because the labels were produced by the project author with AI assistance, they should be reviewed by a second human annotator before quoting as a benchmark.
